answer: Barley sacks stand in rows on the maltster floor, the steeping cistern full. Proof of maltster via malted barley tally — a batch the maltster steeps only after 283 batches malt true without one souring at the floor, each steeped by the maltster himself. vertex steeps the grain in the cistern and drains it after a day. kernel spreads the barley on the floor and turns it twice a day. signal kilns the malt slow and tests a handful for the sweet smell. Two hundred and eighty-three batches must malt true without one souring at the floor, and the next still sours where the grain ran damp.
